About_Us.desc: LightingUp Expert is designed to make flashlight access faster and more convenient while keeping your home screen simple and easy to navigate. You can instantly turn on the torch, switch between practical light modes, and access your everyday apps with ease. Our goal is to provide a smooth, user-friendly experience that seamlessly combines essential flashlight tools with a clean, minimalist launcher design for your daily needs.

ques.ansTitle: Why does my home screen look different?
ques.ans:
LightingUp Expert Launcher gives your home screen a new layout designed for quicker access to flashlight tools, useful shortcuts, and your apps.
If you want to access your apps, just swipe up from the bottom of the screen to find and open them easily.

How to Restore Your Original Home Screen:
If you're not satisfied with the new layout, you can switch back to your previous launcher at any time. Keep in mind that if you stop using LightingUp Expert Launcher as your default home app, quick access to flashlight tools and launcher features may no longer be available. To switch back, tap the button below to set your preferred launcher as the default.

LightingUp Expert Launcher is a free, ad-supported app that allows us to offer the service to all users at no cost. If you find the number of ads bothersome, please feel free to let us know-we appreciate your feedback.

ques.que: How to use LightingUp Expert Launcher?
ques.ans:
Step 1: Open the Flashlight Panel

Swipe to access the flashlight panel, where you can quickly turn on the torch and switch between different lighting modes.

Step 2: Switch Flashlight Modes

Use the available modes to switch between Torch, SOS, and other light features quickly and easily.

Step 3: Quick Google Search Access

Use the Google search bar on the main page to perform searches directly from your home screen. Whether you prefer typing or voice commands, this feature makes it quick and easy to find what you need without launching a separate app, increasing your productivity.

ques.que: How do I remove new apps from my home screen?
ques.ans: To remove an app, swipe up from the home screen, then long-press the app icon. Next, tap on App info and select the option to uninstall or remove the app.
A launcher controls how your home screen and app list look and behave. LightingUp Expert Launcher also adds quick access to flashlight tools, making your device more convenient for everyday use.
